**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

- **What exists:** Section 9 "Warranties" covers only mutual corporate existence/authority/enforceability/non-conflict (9(a)) and the Globix carve-out (9(b)). Sections 1, 2 and 5 impose delivery and operational duties on HDI but contain no conformity or performance warranty, no duration and no remedy.
- **Disclaimer check:** no "AS IS", merchantability/fitness or implied-warranty disclaimer anywhere, so this is not walk-away territory — but the fallback fails on all four material terms.
- **Cure (fallback, single insert as new 9(c)):** 90 days' conformity of the Site/software to documentation, 30 days for the services, with repair, replacement or refund at the Company's election. Preferred extras (workmanlike standard, 12 months, compliance with laws, no malicious code) were deliberately not added, keeping the change to the shortest complete fallback-level clause.
